title: Quantum Liang Information Flow vs. Out-of-Time-Order Correlators as Chaos Diagnostics in the Mixed-Field Ising Chain
summary: We systematically compare Quantum Liang Information Flow (QLIF) a recently proposed causal information measure with the out-of-time-order correlator (OTOC) as diagnostics of quantum chaos in the one-dimensional mixed-field Ising chain. Using exact diagonalization and MPS-TEBD, we show that the early-time power-law growth and wavefront propagation velocity of QLIF are identical for integrable and chaotic parameters, being controlled solely by the local Hamiltonian structure.
